user_story: As a credit analyst/CCOE, I want to log in to the spreading portal through single sign-on (SSO via TOP) so that I can start spreading a borrower's statements in one place.
pre_condition: Analyst/CCOE has a valid account and assigned role.
business_rules: 1. Access is through SSO for KTB Employees. CCOE Central Team can use a direct log in.
